intended_object: An auxiliary expression from a proof: the explicit time primitive t ↦ (k⋆w₀)(x) + ∫ₐᵗ ((Δk)⋆w + (∂ⱼk)⋆Hⱼ + k⋆f)(x, s) ds. The theorem `vlConvT_ae_eq_prim` shows that the convolved weak heat solution (k⋆w(t))(x) equals it for almost every t. I inferred this from the docstring, the module documentation and how the file uses it.
explanation: The body matches the formula in the module documentation exactly. It is `vlConv k w₀ x`, which is Mathlib's `convolution` with `lsmul`, plus the interval integral from a to t of `vlSource`. `vlSource` is the convolved right-hand side: ∑ⱼ (∂ⱼ∂ⱼk)⋆w + ∑ⱼ (∂ⱼk)⋆Hⱼ + k⋆f, evaluated on the time slice. Its only role is to name the right-hand side of the almost-everywhere identity in `vlConvT_ae_eq_prim`, which is one time step of the localized vorticity energy lemma. It is a proof-specific device, a named formula used in one intermediate lemma, not a standard mathematical notion with its own place in the literature. So there is no intended object to compare it against, and no question of its generality. As a device, it does what the documentation describes.
